description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Notify the Statement of Alternative Treatment (SOAT) on the Figures in the Interim Financial Statement, w.e.f. 01.08.2018
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to the adoption of a new accounting standard (Statement of Alternative Treatment) by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka under the authority of the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. It establishes regulatory requirements for financial reporting practices, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government structure/personnel announcement or other specialized category.
